-- Check how to extract numeric value from size column like "24.71 GB"
SELECT size, SUBSTRING(size FROM '([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*)') as numeric_size FROM scans LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    p.flowsoft as processing_software,
    p.flowstage as processing_stage,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs' AS numeric)), 2) as avg_processing_hours,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU' AS numeric)), 2) as avg_cpu_usage,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU' AS numeric)), 2) as avg_gpu_usage,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(s.size FROM '([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*)') AS numeric)), 2) as avg_data_size_gb,
    ROUND(AVG(
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(s.size FROM '([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*)') AS numeric) * LN(CAST(pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts' AS numeric)) / LN(10.0)) 
        / (CAST(p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs' AS numeric) * (CAST(p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU' AS numeric) + CAST(p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU' AS numeric)) / 200.0)
    ), 4) as avg_efficiency_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(
            (CAST(SUBSTRING(s.size FROM '([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*)') AS numeric) * LN(CAST(pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts' AS numeric)) / LN(10.0)) 
            / (CAST(p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs' AS numeric) * (CAST(p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU' AS numeric) + CAST(p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU' AS numeric)) / 200.0)
        ) < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck'
        ELSE 'Normal'
    END as efficiency_status,
    COUNT(*) as total_workflows
FROM processing p
JOIN scans s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneref
JOIN pointcloud pc ON s.crewref = pc.crewref AND s.arcref = pc.arcref
GROUP BY p.flowsoft, p.flowstage
ORDER BY p.flowsoft, p.flowstage;

-- Check if any individual records have PER < 0.5
SELECT 
    p.flowsoft, p.flowstage,
    ROUND(AVG(
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(s.size FROM '([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*)') AS numeric) * LN(CAST(pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts' AS numeric)) / LN(10.0)) 
        / (CAST(p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs' AS numeric) * (CAST(p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU' AS numeric) + CAST(p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU' AS numeric)) / 200.0)
    ), 4) as avg_efficiency_value
FROM processing p
JOIN scans s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneref
JOIN pointcloud pc ON s.crewref = pc.crewref AND s.arcref = pc.arcref
GROUP BY p.flowsoft, p.flowstage
HAVING AVG(
    (CAST(SUBSTRING(s.size FROM '([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*)') AS numeric) * LN(CAST(pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts' AS numeric)) / LN(10.0)) 
    / (CAST(p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs' AS numeric) * (CAST(p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU' AS numeric) + CAST(p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU' AS numeric)) / 200.0)
) < 0.5;

-- Check individual record PER values
SELECT 
    p.flowregistry, p.flowsoft, p.flowstage,

        (CAST(SUBSTRING(s.size FROM '([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*)') AS numeric) * LN(CAST(pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts' AS numeric)) / LN(10.0)) 
        / (CAST(p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs' AS numeric) * (CAST(p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU' AS numeric) + CAST(p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU' AS numeric)) / 200.0),
